in_sanskrit.name: शुरेंद्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is victorious and brave. The one who has the power to conquer. A storehouse of valor.

in_hindi.name: शुरेंद्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one with great strength. The one who bestows victory.

in_tamil.name: சுரேந்திர
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has victory. The one who is like a lion.

in_telugu.name: శూరెంద్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of victory.

in_marathi.name: Surendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Obtainer of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘surendra’, meaning ‘the one who has control over all senses and the lord of the universe’. It symbolizes courage, strength, and victory.
